stage: 2 necessity, terminology and word choice only

reviewer.exact_model_and_reasoning: Not exposed to reviewer; no invented version or setting

checkpoint.state: one source-level duplicate first-definition mark in eye pathway YAML; checking final context and writing record

scope.sidecars: All corresponding YAML, including tables, captions, alt text, summaries and titles
scope.upstream: Focused actual passages listed per record, not a claim of full Chapters 1-6 review

freeze.root_notice: Only separate routes feedback sentence and reference ordering changed; this assigned path is unchanged.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Fixational drift, systematic drift, shared drive, OMNs and ocular plant
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: Keep the distinction between slow eye motion and mean velocity. These words name different measured or modeled objects. The pathway gives the actor and receiving stage before upstream is used as an inference.
retained_passages.deletion_test: Without this distinction the same word drift could wrongly make observed movement imply directional bias. The one-cell/two-animal limits determine what covariance can be measured.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: First local definitions of microsaccades, nucleus and plant are needed; integrator and attractor are reminders linked to earlier teaching.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Threshold, neural lead, fitted coefficients, t test and p value
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: The threshold belongs to the position term, lead specifies which time predicts which, and fitted m is separated from mass. The test and p value are necessary to interpret the stated experimental result.
retained_passages.deletion_test: Removing units or time direction would make the inversion harder to interpret. Removing the p-value qualification would leave a familiar number with the wrong possible meaning.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Keep the compact local test definition and the separate derivation panel. No added basic probability lesson is needed.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Causal filter, impulse response, convolution, kernel and static gain
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: Each term is attached to the operation: present output uses past spikes; one spike has response h; convolution adds those responses. Kernel refers back to that same response function and gain is its steady input conversion.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The impulse normalization and static check prevent losing a physical conversion factor. The repeated-pole panel checks the distinct-times formula at its boundary.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Retain these exact filter terms with their current explanations; a broader signal-processing glossary would add no needed step.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Explained fraction, standardized predictor and private variability
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: Explained fraction is tied to optimal linear prediction, not raw spike-predictor accuracy. Standardizing to variance one is stated as an operation. Private describes noise produced separately within each cell, not all activity of that cell.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The residual calculation establishes the independent-source bound; the sampling premise is needed to use it on the recorded cells.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Coefficient of determination earns its technical name beside R squared. No new definition of covariance or variance is needed.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Common contribution, unit gain, prediction noise and weighted error
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: C is explicitly a displacement contribution in degrees. Unit gain is spelled out as one-for-one scale. The reported weighted error belongs to the common estimator and its assumptions.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The constructed numbers distinguish small R from large chi; deleting their interpretation would lose the point of the example. The sample-outside-range discussion explains the plotted estimates.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Keep the short reminders and full calibration/uncertainty qualifiers. They perform different jobs and are not redundant warnings.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Lag, measurement error, plateau and correction
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: Lag is the separation between two measurements. The offset is an error in the measured statistic, not motion of the eye or known trial noise. Plateau names the positive-lag feature.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The zero-lag exception and correlated-error alternative are necessary to apply the subtraction correctly. The uncertainty example demonstrates why a positive corrected value alone is insufficient.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: MSD is recalled with a link and formula; no repeated full foundation is needed.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Superdiffusion, low pass filter, stationarity and Brownian input
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: Superdiffusion is defined over the measured lag range. Stationarity is explicitly mean/covariance stationarity here. The Brownian command and filtered eye output remain distinct. One pole is explained as the one-exponential example.
retained_passages.deletion_test: Removing the long-time distinction would hide why smoothing stationary input differs from smoothing accumulating position. The weighted-increment explanation makes the stochastic integral usable without a new calculus course.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Retain precise filter and stochastic terms; the earlier white-noise and Brownian teaching plus local reminders suffice.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Synaptic output, saturating response, readout and neutral condition
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: The lingering synaptic effect is identified before S appears. The weighted readout supplies the next rates. Saturation is then explained by approaching one. The neutral condition is tied to the stored coordinate.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The fixed-point relation adds the missing condition that recurrence alone does not imply persistence. Approximate optimization and stable transverse directions preserve the strength of the claim.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: These are extensions of earlier neural definitions; the local meanings and different units warrant reminders rather than a second foundational chapter.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Motor output, effective contribution, neural and muscle time scales, feedback delay
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: Each motor quantity has a specific job. E_i is an effective contribution, not a separate physical eye. Delayed visual feedback is described through recent image motion, with the approximation stated.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The comparison between a lag in a running process and time after perturbation is needed to avoid a false delay cutoff. The two motor counts identify different experiments.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Keep repeated exact time-constant symbols and their owners. Replacing them by a generic response time would erase the distinction.

retained_passages.terms_checked: CV, sub-Poisson, renewal, absolute and fractional slope
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: CV has an earlier definition and a plain local reminder. Sub-Poisson is limited to the stated count measure. Renewal is defined where independent intervals justify the count-variance calculation. Absolute and fractional slopes are given different symbols and units.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The rate/slope comparison is needed because a rate change alone is not a complete parameter comparison. Deleting the qualification would make the printed inverse-rate form look universally applicable.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Retain these technical terms and the short interval construction. An exhaustive taxonomy of non-Poisson processes is unnecessary.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Within-segment variance and CV caused by drift
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: The average over a fixation and the squared time mean are different quantities, both identified before subtraction. The interval-rate expansion ties position variation to interval variation.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The calculation tests whether the measured regularity could mostly be a consequence of drift. The small-result comparison gives it a clear reason to be here.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: No extra general lesson on sample versus population variance is needed; the displayed time averages show the objects used.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Figure evidence, rank correlation, direct output noise and circuit location
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: Spearman correlation is explained by ranking observations. The paragraph distinguishes direct output spikes from internally generated diffusion. Upstream means before OMNs, not necessarily inside one specified integrator.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The figure guide separates what each comparison establishes. The unmeasured-integrator and untested-necessity statements are needed limits on circuit identification.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Keep exact figure labels and the rank-operation definition. Do not replace them with a broad claim that all figures prove the model.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Gaussian process, jointly Gaussian, stationarity, isotropy, smoothness and excursion set
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: Each assumption has a separate meaning and a use: joint distributions permit conditional independence, stationarity supplies equal local laws, isotropy removes preferred direction, and smoothness permits derivatives. Nondegenerate is immediately explained using an invertible covariance matrix. Excursion set is the above-threshold set.
retained_passages.deletion_test: Deleting these definitions would make the crossing and peak arguments rely on assumptions readers cannot identify. The fixed-map/time distinction prevents a change of subject.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Keep first blue terms and the compact mathematical definition panel. They are needed here and do not require a general statistics chapter.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Upcrossing, crossing density, slope weighting and endpoint correction
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: Upcrossing is defined before counting. Density means expected crossings per distance. The narrow-band width explains why multiplying by the slope counts each crossing once.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The endpoint term is needed because the chosen count retains clipped components. The exact/not-high-threshold statement keeps this method separate from the later limiting size law.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Kac-Rice is the established name of the equation already derived, not an unexplained substitute for its mechanism.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Stationary per-field means, gaps, conditioned counts and Poisson approximation
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: Field length and gap length have different denominators from uniform-position occupancy. The text explicitly excludes a finite-sample ratio claim. Conditioned count is tied to excluding silent cells.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The inversion separates threshold from spatial scale. The long-distance decorrelation condition and finite-boundary warning preserve the method limits.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Retain the local Q/Phi reminder and the short selection example; neither calls for a fresh probability primer.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Hessian, high excursion, asymptotic peak and linear size
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: Hessian is defined as the second-derivative matrix before use. High excursion is a connected above-threshold region already taught. Linear size is distinguished from area or volume.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The conditions and finite-threshold comparisons keep the local approximation honest. The excess-height scaling explains the eventual size law rather than asserting it.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Keep the exact mathematical terms with their current concrete meanings; avoid new names for the same curvature calculation.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Gamma, density, dimensionless size, survival probability and Weibull
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: Gamma has its defining integral and factorial relation. Survival probability is immediately translated as chance of a field being larger than a cutoff. Removing units is separated from changing distribution shape.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The moment and unit checks establish the constants. The source-error panel explains a consequential disagreement with printed equations and does not accuse the code or data fits.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Rayleigh/exponential/Weibull names are useful because the table identifies different laws. Their precise qualifiers should stay.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Spatial restriction, slice components and sampling a field
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: Restriction means evaluating the same map on a line or plane. The object counted is explicitly a component within that slice. Sampling lines is distinguished from cutting each original field at its center.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The hit-probability distinction is needed to explain why the original radius law cannot simply be reused for slice lengths. It adds a separate test of the spatial model.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Keep the ordinary verbs cut, hit and count beside the exact Gaussian restriction statement.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Typical crossing slope and finite-difference estimate
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: Typical refers to crossings sampled once each, not uniformly sampled spatial positions. Slope weighting is linked back to the earlier crossing integral. The measured slope is a rate difference over 0.1 m.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The explanation answers why a Gaussian derivative becomes Rayleigh at selected boundaries. Removing the measurement qualifier would imply direct input observations.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: The earlier Rayleigh definition is appropriately reused as plain text; no second blue definition is added.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Euler characteristic, Betti numbers, critical point and Morse theory
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: Components, loops and cavities are first explained through disks, rings and shells. The formal names then identify those counts. Critical point means zero gradient, and Morse theory is introduced for its signed counting role.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The named theorem is needed to justify the bridge from geometry to the expectation formula. The text states what is borrowed and what algebra it derives.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Keep exact topology names with these examples. A general topology survey would not help this local calculation.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Boundary face, signed density, high-threshold count and cutoff conversion
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: Boundary terms belong to the observed box. Signed densities are explicitly not positive field counts. The applied rate cutoff is converted into a normalized level using the already defined gain.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The finite-domain corrections and high-q approximation have different jobs. The limiting checks and negative-EC example keep their interpretation separate.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Retain local definitions and qualifiers. No new geometry terminology beyond faces, side lengths and volume is needed.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Fitted feature, additional comparison, skew, kurtosis, median filter and curvature
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: The reader can see which summaries choose parameters and which are further checks. Skew and kurtosis describe centered log-length moments. Median filter states the replacement operation. Curvature is explained as bending in principal directions.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The processing list changes what a field is, so it belongs with the evidence. The fitted-threshold extension and in-sample comparison limits prevent overcounting predictions.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Keep these exact measurement names. Their local explanations are shorter and more useful than a detached glossary expansion.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Input profile, weight, Gaussian limit and covariance width
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: The sending input cell, its fixed profile, the receiving cell and the sampled weights are all identified. The Gaussian limit has normalization and no-dominant-input conditions. Width conventions are made explicit.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The covariance derivation distinguishes amplitude from spatial dependence. The final mechanism limits are needed because rate maps do not measure synaptic weights.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Retain the mathematical term multivariate central limit condition together with its stated role; no theorem proof is promised here.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Weight, neural state, remembered value, neuromorphic computing and working memory
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: The three objects are explicitly distinguished by what they represent and how they change. Working memory is limited to later task access; persistent activity is one possible implementation.
retained_passages.deletion_test: Removing the ring example would lose the concrete demonstration that identical weights can retain different cues while a displaced activity pattern changes the answer.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Definitions are introduced at the first detailed hardware use. The repeated ordinary word memory is kept because replacing it with separate invented labels would obscure the comparison.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Current, voltage, capacitance, digital storage, SRAM, analog state, PCM and conductance
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: The physical quantities are taught before the update mechanism uses them. Storage names identify real implementation choices, each with a different state and error. Nonvolatile is explicitly power-independent retention within limits.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The electrical definitions are needed for Q=CV and I=GV. The mismatch/noise distinction prepares two different error causes rather than adding an unrelated device list.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Keep the first blue definitions and their units; their density follows the required physics, not an encyclopedia detour.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Event, physical analog update, mixed signal and in-memory multiplication
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: The prose follows an input: identify connections, add weighted input, update state and send events. The analog version identifies current and voltage. PCM separates conductance as weight from pulse duration as input.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The multiplication example adds what the storage table alone cannot explain. Signed handling is a necessary limit on the simple positive contribution.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Keep mixed-signal and in-memory computing as precise defined names. The text explains their operations rather than relying on the labels.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Feedback gain, component time, collective time and linear mode
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: Gain is a fraction of the loss replaced in this equation. The component and collective decay times are different. Mode refers to the single small disturbance u already specified.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The sensitivity example demonstrates why a long collective time needs close balance. The local linear-model scope prevents treating it as an entire physical-chip description.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Use a short reminder of feedback rather than repeating the original synaptic model.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Restoration, neutral direction, region of attraction, pinning and bit errors
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: Restoration pushes small displacements back; a neutral displacement preserves another valid continuous value. Pinning is defined by attraction toward preferred states. The local variance result explicitly excludes rare state switches.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The digital/analog qualification is needed to separate physical medium from dynamics. The bound-transfer limits prevent using a neural result as a universal electronic-memory law.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Retain exact neutral and pinning terms with the present action-based explanation.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Finite resolution, bistability and physical demonstration
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: Finite angular spacing makes resolution concrete. Bistability is explained as two locally stable states under the same conditions. The demonstrations preserve different types of values.
retained_passages.deletion_test: Deleting their scope limits would invite calling every persistent chip a continuous Brownian memory. The examples justify separating these experimental claims.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: No additional historical hardware survey is needed for the distinction.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Host computer, calibration, on-chip learning and acceleration
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: The host is defined before host/chip division is compared. Calibration means adjusting settings to match desired responses. Learning computes and applies some weight changes. Acceleration compares model and physical time.
retained_passages.deletion_test: These definitions make the architecture table answer where each operation happens. The capability/application distinction is needed to interpret the following studies.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Keep local hardware meanings even where calibration or learning has earlier biological uses; they specify a different actor and operation.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Input history, deterministic dynamics, jitter, weight adaptation and material drift
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: Input history is a changing state summarizing earlier signals. The Aitsam paragraph names host smoothing, chip updates, centroid movement, jitter and lag separately. PCM studies distinguish adapted weights and drift in their material readout.
retained_passages.deletion_test: Every stated limit changes what the result can support about cue retention. Removing the error/lag values would hide the cost of lower jitter.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Retain the plain statement that no stochastic neural-noise term was added. It defines the intended sense of deterministic without claiming perfect physical hardware.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Legendre memory unit, registers, post-layout simulation and slow state
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: The exact LMU name is followed by its needed role, a few components summarizing a recent window. Registers are small digital storage. Post-layout simulations are identified as designed-circuit models rather than fabricated-chip measurements.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The one-state example teaches time conversion while explicitly keeping its simpler scope. The four-chip paragraph adds the relevant communication constraint.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Keep the source architecture name with the short functional explanation; a derivation of Legendre polynomials is unnecessary for this comparison.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Decoder, cue writing, unwrapping, local diffusion and readout noise
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: A decoder is a specified estimation rule with defined signal access. Earlier examples use decoding, while this protocol makes the rule and calibration requirements explicit. Unwrapping is explained by full-turn adjustment and sampling limits.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The immediate-after-cue record separates writing from retention error. The offset model separates readout uncertainty from true state movement. These are necessary operational steps.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Keep the local decoder explanation for the protocol. It adds the observable-input and fixed-rule conditions rather than repeating a full readout derivation.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Noise projection, left neutral vector, fixed mismatch and precision
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: The left vector is identified with the earlier v and its normalization. B maps temporal independent disturbances, while fixed mismatch changes f. Numerical precision is the number of representable state/update levels.
retained_passages.deletion_test: Without these owners, changing a device parameter would not explain why decoded error changes. The bias/variance example shows why a narrower distribution may retain cues worse.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Retain the exact left-vector term and short reminder. A second eigenvector tutorial is unnecessary after Part I.

retained_passages.terms_checked: Matched readout, output filter, model versus physical time and energy boundary
retained_passages.meaning_actor_object_condition: The comparison identifies which observations a decoder receives, which output stage smooths the command and which clock measures diffusion. Energy is attached to writing, waiting and reading including necessary host work.
retained_passages.deletion_test: The three-paper links say what each result constrains. The final question asks which actual component limits retention, completing the purpose of the hardware comparison.
retained_passages.definition_or_reminder: Keep these task-specific reminders and qualifications. They are not a repeated generic warning or a claim that every platform already ran the protocol.
